# DoGood Agency

> DoGood Agency is a private coaching practice for founders before and after they sell their business. It works alongside their exit, succession and wealth advisors. It does not give financial, tax or legal advice.

DoGood works on the personal side of selling a business: who the founder is without the company, what comes next, and how to step into it. Founders work 1:1 with Seb Wichmann (founder) or one of a small team of Wayfinders. All work is private and remote, with optional in-person elements in the Founder Reclamation Partnership.

DoGood is for founders before the sale and founders after the sale.

Selling in the next few years? Start with Exit-Prep. Already sold? Apply for Stage 1. We reply within 24 hours.

## Offers

- [Exit-Prep](https://www.dogoodagency.co/exit-prep): six weekly 1:1 sessions for founders who haven't sold yet. Fully remote. Ideally started 12 to 18 months before the sale.
- [The Founder Reclamation Partnership (FRP)](https://www.dogoodagency.co/the-reset): a private two-stage partnership for founders after the sale. Stage 1, The Reset, runs for 30 days. Stage 2, The Build, runs for 12 weeks and is by invitation only.
- [ClarityValue Shift™](https://www.dogoodagency.co/clarityvalue-shift): the 4-step method inside Stage 1, The Reset: See, Interrupt, Choose, Reset.
- [NextLife Passage™](https://www.dogoodagency.co/nextlife-passage): the 4-step method inside Stage 2, The Build: Rework, Navigate, Realign, Integrate.
- [How it works](https://www.dogoodagency.co/pathway): which door fits: Exit-Prep before the sale, The Reset and The Build after it.
- [Apply for Stage 1](https://www.dogoodagency.co/application)

## For advisors

- [Advisor Center](https://www.dogoodagency.co/advisor-center): how DoGood works with exit planners, succession and wealth advisors, accountants and attorneys whose clients are selling, and how to refer a founder.

## About

Our vision: Every entrepreneur builds consciously: a life of creation and service that does good to them, to the people they love and to the world.

Our mission: We put tools for the human side of entrepreneurship in the hands of every entrepreneur on the planet, and walk beside founders 1:1 when the stakes are highest, starting with the sale.

- [About DoGood](https://www.dogoodagency.co/about): why DoGood exists and the people behind the work.
- [Wayfinders](https://www.dogoodagency.co/wayfinders): the team who guide founders through the partnership.
- [Seb Wichmann](https://www.dogoodagency.co/wayfinders/seb): founder of DoGood and author of the Insights articles.
- [Stories](https://www.dogoodagency.co/stories): anonymized founder case studies and words from organizations the team has worked with.
- [FAQs](https://www.dogoodagency.co/faqs): timing, format, privacy and how the stages work.
